title: Overpowered Mastery
description: Overpowered tools, items and armor that don't follow the vanilla way!
body:
# Welcome To The World of Overpowered Mastery!

This mod adds overpowered tools and weapons (even new weapon types), items, blocks, oh and some **fun** of course.

- _Have an unfair mob?_ **No problem, just use one of the weapons!**
- _Want some protection that stops all those bypasses?_ **We got you covered!**
- _Need a fancy tool that is not the same old pickaxe?_ **Craft one with this mod!**
- _Want ridiculous amounts of power even if you don't need it?_ **It's here!**

This mod _refuses_ to follow the _vanilla_ way, adding features like those seen in **1.5-1.7 era of modding**. Of course, some items will be balanced, but expect the unexpected. **Anything could be added in the mod at any time.**

_Don't like unbalanced and overpowered items?_ No problem, just don't download the mod! It's that simple!

**Welcome back to the OVERPOWERED MASTERY of MC!**
